title: DIY Outdoor Sofa Set (3+1+1 Seater)
excerpt: Complete guide to building a custom outdoor sofa set using pine lumber, designed for durability and comfort.
body:
## Overview
In this project I built a complete outdoor sofa set (3+1+1 seater) for my porch, focusing on durability, comfort and a clean modern look.

The goal was to create a robust outdoor seating solution using affordable materials while ensuring the structure could withstand exterior conditions.

## Materials
To build this project I used three different sizes of pine lumber:

- 9 pieces — 70mm x 30mm x 2600mm
- 8 pieces — 140mm x 30mm x 2600mm
- 5 pieces — 100mm x 50mm x 2600mm

Pine is a great choice for outdoor projects when properly treated and sealed.

## Build Process
After cutting all components to size, each piece was sanded and pre-drilled to ensure clean assembly and precise alignment.

The structure was assembled using:
- Dowels for alignment and strength
- Wood glue for durability
- Screws for structural integrity

This combination ensures a rigid and long-lasting frame capable of supporting daily use.

## Finishing
To protect the wood from outdoor conditions, I applied three coats of exterior varnish.

This step is essential to:
- Protect against moisture
- Prevent UV damage
- Extend the lifespan of the furniture

## Final Result
Once the structure was fully assembled and finished, I added custom-made cushions for comfort.

The final result is a solid, stylish and functional outdoor sofa set, ideal for relaxing and entertaining.
